result:
Direct calls, in order:

- `pathguard::PathGuard::new` — write confinement guard (INV-3/4)
- `walk::walk` — filesystem walk → `File`/dir nodes
- `lang::extract_and_resolve` — per-file extract + whole-repo resolve → symbols/imports/calls
- `Graph::new`, `Graph::insert_node`, `Graph::insert_edge` (`crate::graph::Graph`)
- `gitinfo::head_sha` — commit SHA for manifest
- `graph::PersistMeta` (struct construct)
- `graph::persist` — sort/redact/validate/write through guard

Returns own `IndexReport` struct. Depends on `crate::error::Result` too.
